seo.meta_title: What Is Pickleman's? The Missouri Toasted Sandwich Chain
seo.meta_description: Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe is a Missouri chain known for toasted sandwiches, pizza and late-night delivery. Its history, locations and what to order.

question: What Is Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe?
quick_answer: Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe is a fast-casual chain from Columbia, Missouri, known for hot toasted sandwiches, plus pizzas, soups and salads. It was founded in 2005 by Doug Stritzel, a former Jimmy John's executive, and has grown to more than 30 locations in Missouri, Kansas, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Indiana, Nebraska and Texas. Sandwiches run about $8 to $12, and many locations offer delivery and late-night hours.
key_facts: Founder Doug Stritzel is a former Jimmy John's COO
Known for toasted sandwiches, pizza, soups and salads
Uses No Antibiotics Ever chicken and pork

body.heading: How Pickleman's started
body.text: Doug Stritzel, a former chief operating officer at Jimmy John's, opened the first Pickleman's in Columbia, Missouri, in 2005. Unlike Jimmy John's cold subs, Pickleman's focused on hot, toasted sandwiches on gourmet bread. It quickly became a favorite with University of Missouri students, and it began franchising, with its first St. Louis location opening near Saint Louis University in 2010.

body.heading: Where Pickleman's is
body.text: Pickleman's now has more than 30 locations, and one 2026 report counted 35, across Missouri, Kansas, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Indiana, Nebraska and Texas. Most are franchised, and many franchisees run several locations. The chain is expanding in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, starting with a cafe in Plano, and has added its first drive-thru in the Kansas City suburb of Olathe.

body.heading: What to order
body.text: Pickleman's menu centers on toasted sandwiches like the #1 Turkey and Italian Beef, along with 12-inch pizzas, soups such as Tomato Basil Bisque, and salads. Many items are made from scratch, and Pickleman's says it was the first national sandwich chain to commit to No Antibiotics Ever chicken and pork. Sandwiches run about $8 to $12 and pizzas about $12 to $19, depending on location.

body.heading: Delivery and late-night hours
body.text: From its early days, Pickleman's has offered late-night hours, fast delivery and catering, which helped make it a college-town staple. Hours and delivery areas vary by location. See our Pickleman's menu page for prices.
